quick_skim.title: IDSD: Iterative Deep-Learning-Based Signal Decomposition
quick_skim.abstract: Data-driven signal decomposition methods decompose a signal into its underlying components in a flexible and adaptive way, taking into account the signal characteristics. Here we focus on univariate signals, whose decomposition is ill-posed. Classical univariate approaches -- like variational mode decomposition -- constrain the solution space (e.g. through narrowband priors), and often require the number of components to be known in advance. These assumption, however, limit the algorithm's usage in certain real-life applications. Instead, we exploit the flexibility of neural networks to replace fixed (narrowband) priors with data-driven priors. Our model, called Iterative Deep-Learning-Based Signal Decomposition (IDSD), iteratively extracts an adaptive number of various types of components from a signal, with no restrictions on the bandwidth of a component. We show superior performance of IDSD both in a controlled setup with synthetic data, and on two real datasets concerning tidal waves and physiological measurements.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: deep-learning-based iterative signal decomposition applicable to EEG artifact removal
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 基于深度学习的迭代信号分解方法可迁移用于EEG伪迹去除
quick_skim.llm_evidence: 基于深度学习的迭代信号分解方法可迁移用于EEG伪迹去除
quick_skim.canonical_evidence: 基于深度学习的迭代信号分解方法可迁移用于EEG伪迹去除
quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: IDSD iteratively decomposes univariate signals with adaptive components using neural network priors, offering a flexible data-driven alternative to classical methods that could support EEG artifact separation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对经典单变量信号分解方法依赖窄带先验且需预知分量数的问题，提出迭代深度学习信号分解（IDSD），利用神经网络学习数据驱动先验，迭代提取自适应数量的分量。在多种信号任务上展示了灵活性和适应性，可作为一种通用信号分解工具。该方法有望迁移到脑电信号处理，为认知负荷评估中的伪迹去除和成分分离提供新途径。
